column2: WARNING Station Heat Trace Service Sign – Heater Circuit May Stay Live – 8x12 Aluminum
column3:
Heater Circuit May Stay Live. This WARNING Station Heat Trace Service sign from CGAP Safety reads: STATION HEAT TRACE SERVICE / HEATER CIRCUIT MAY STAY LIVE / WITH PROCESS DISCONNECT OPEN / ISOLATE AND TEST HEATER SUPPLY. Written for Transmission substations, control houses, switchyard auxiliary systems.

Why this sign matters

The heat trace feed is separate from the process circuit, so the heater conductors can stay energized with the process disconnect open and shock a tech who opens the box.

Where to post it

Mount on the heat trace distribution panel door in the substation control house, beside the process disconnect.

Who orders it

Substation maintenance electricians and relay techs.

Rust-resistant .065 aluminum, UV-resistant print, pre-drilled in all four corners. Made in the USA. Related standards to review for your site: OSHA 1910.333; NFPA 70E; ANSI Z535.2. A sign supports your safety program; it does not replace guarding, lockout or training.
